description:
Outcome: Coordinator receives one daily email listing new reports (owner notification answer).
Scope: Durable cursor/batch, configurable local schedule/timezone, coordinator-only authenticated links, escaped content, delivery ledger, idempotent jobs/provider capability, retry/catch-up and observable failures. Excludes: immediate notifications and other recipients.
Acceptance: Daily summary contains all new reports including since-resolved ones; empty days get no-new-reports summary. Cutoff arrivals not lost. Overlap/retry cannot duplicate batch/delivery; provider acceptance/local crash reconciled. Failed sends retain backlog; no gardener contact details in email.
Behaviour: Retry without loss; coordinator/operator can see failures. Block release until delivery deduplication mechanism proven.
Verification: Fake clock/transport tests for cutoffs, outages, overlap, restart and ambiguous provider responses; real sandbox delivery before acceptance. Prerequisites: T-012. Assumptions: 09:00 garden local time, empty-day summary, provider capability established in T-001.
title: Send one daily new-report digest
